bioghist.head: Biographical Information
bioghist.p: Laura Sandy received her Ph.D. from the University of Manchester in 2006. She is currently on the faculty at the University of Liverpool.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Content
scopecontent.p: Manuscript dissertation, 2006, by Laura Sandy submitted to the University of Manchester for the degree of Doctor of Philosophy titled Between Planter and Slave: The Social and Economic Role of Plantation Overseers in Virginia and South Carolina, 1740-1790.
